name: tt-debug-tools
description: Drive the Tenstorrent debug tools and read their output — watcher, kernel prints, triage, asserts, profiler, board and cluster state.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the tt-metal debug tools and read their output
interface.longDescription: One skill per debugging question. Each teaches how to put the stack in a state where a tool produces output, how to run it, and how to read what comes back — tt-triage, watcher, kernel prints, asserts, NoC tracing, profiling, and board state.
defaultPrompt: My Tenstorrent job is hung — get me the device state.
